findings.problem: The scoped comparison accepts parsed identity/totals/sector maps without validating accepted-report terminal completeness or the declared scan-row structure. Duplicate keys and sectors silently overwrite; missing fields are not rejected as a schema failure. Hosted scan_whole checks only scan_out_of_range and a positive reads total. Consequently a report truncated after its final scan row but before its verdict can compare EQUAL_AT_SCOPE, and duplicated/omitted row structures can be collapsed into matching maps while scan_whole remains 1. This defeats the new whole scoped-comparison gate.

A malformed or incomplete scoped input must not become EQUAL_AT_SCOPE or SCAN_ONLY/scan_whole=1.
